Meet Dr. Jenna Davis

Chiropractor. Educator. Creator.

Helping practitioners and families unlock the full potential of pediatric and prenatal health.

Dr. Jenna Davis is a family chiropractor, international speaker, and educator based in Oakville, Ontario. She is the founder of Acorn Family Health and Wellness Centre, a thriving multidisciplinary clinic dedicated to family wellness at every stage of life.

Dr. Jenna specializes in preconception, infertility, prenatal and postnatal care, pediatrics, intraoral function, developmental delay and women's health. She has a gift for making complex health information feel simple, relevant and empowering, so every family she works with feels truly heard and supported.

Speaker. Author. Educator.

Beyond her clinic walls, Dr. Jenna is a sought-after speaker who has taken the stage in Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom and Australia. She speaks on topics including pediatric and prenatal care, infertility, tongue-tie and oral function, women's health, team-based care, niche marketing and work-life balance.

A lifelong learner at heart, Dr. Jenna is constantly expanding her knowledge through postgraduate training, research and collaboration, because she believes the best care starts with the best education.

The P.I.P.S.™ Technique

Dr. Jenna is the founder of the P.I.P.S.™ (Pediatric Intraoral Palate Specific) Technique, a groundbreaking assessment and care approach for infants and children experiencing challenges with breastfeeding, tongue-tie, lip-tie, TMJD, low tone, reflux and cranial tension. Since its creation in 2016, the P.I.P.S. Technique has become a go-to method for practitioners around the world.
